description.value:
Cut from a living donor's marrow while both of you were open on the same table; the two marrow-lines never fully separated. Fast Healing 3 whenever the donor is alive, anywhere. Once per day, reaction: when you'd take damage that would drop you, shunt half of it down the cord into the donor instead, no save, no range limit.

Donor: The donor is a real, specific, living person the GM controls. They feel your pain as phantom sensation in real time, and if they die the graft necroses on the spot: you're stunned 1 and take 2d6 negative damage as it dies inside you.

cinderfall.incomplete: Fast healing conditioned on a specific NPC's life status can't be predicated (no roll option tracks a named NPC's vital status for a FastHealing predicate), and the damage-shunt-to-the-donor reaction targets another creature's HP with no range limit -- the same architecture gap as Grave-Quiet/Loyal-Blood, compounded here by a second creature's death consequence.
